mapper.sql: category_id AS categoryId, parent_id AS parentId, category_code AS categoryCode, category_name AS categoryName, order_num AS orderNum, status, remark
location_id AS locationId, parent_id AS parentId, location_code AS locationCode, location_name AS locationName, location_type AS locationType, dept_id AS deptId, order_num AS orderNum, status, remark
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM ca_category
AND (category_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR category_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY order_num, category_id
mapper.sql: a.asset_id AS assetId, a.asset_code AS assetCode, a.asset_name AS assetName, a.category_id AS categoryId, a.specification, a.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, a.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, a.supplier_name AS supplierName, a.expected_use_years AS expectedUseYears, a.registered_time AS registeredTime, a.dept_id AS deptId, a.location_id AS locationId, a.keeper_user_id AS keeperUserId, a.asset_status AS assetStatus, a.condition_status AS conditionStatus, a.borrow_enabled AS borrowEnabled, a.visibility, a.qr_token AS qrToken, a.scrapped_time AS scrappedTime, a.remark, c.category_name AS categoryName, l.location_name AS locationName, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.nick_name AS keeperName

FROM ca_asset a LEFT JOIN ca_category c ON c.category_id=a.category_id LEFT JOIN ca_location l ON l.location_id=a.location_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=a.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=a.keeper_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ca_borrow WHERE asset_id=#{id} AND status IN ('0','2','3','4')) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ca_repair WHERE asset_id=#{id} AND status IN ('0','1','2','3')) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ca_scrap WHERE asset_id=#{id} AND status IN ('0','1'))

SELECT JSON_OBJECT( 'asset_id',CAST(a.asset_id AS CHAR),'asset_code',a.asset_code,'asset_name',a.asset_name, 'category_id',CAST(a.category_id AS CHAR),'category_name',c.category_name, 'dept_id',CAST(a.dept_id AS CHAR),'dept_name',d.dept_name, 'location_id',CAST(a.location_id AS CHAR),'location_name',l.location_name, 'keeper_user_id',CAST(a.keeper_user_id AS CHAR),'keeper_name',u.nick_name, 'specification',a.specification,'purchase_price',CAST(a.purchase_price AS CHAR), 'purchase_date',a.purchase_date,'registered_time',a.registered_time,'scrapped_time',a.scrapped_time, 'asset_status',a.asset_status,'condition_status',a.condition_status, 'borrow_enabled',a.borrow_enabled,'visibility',a.visibility) FROM ca_asset a LEFT JOIN ca_category c ON c.category_id=a.category_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=a.dept_id LEFT JOIN ca_location l ON l.location_id=a.location_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=a.keeper_user_id WHERE a.asset_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE ca_asset SET asset_status=#{status},condition_status=#{condition}, scrapped_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='3' THEN NOW(3) ELSE scrapped_time END, update_by=#{operator},update_time=NOW(3) WHERE asset_id=#{id} AND asset_status=#{expected}
